label_definition.0: first valid SCHEDULE occurs from SUBMIT through 5 seconds inclusive
label_definition.1: no first SCHEDULE by 5 seconds, including a competing earlier terminal event
label_definition.censoring: all SUBMITs require 5 seconds of subsequent trace coverage; 5-minute coverage is audited separately
label_definition.post_window: missing, duplicate, and colliding events later than 5 seconds are counted but cannot remove or relabel an already observed request
label_definition.queue_enable: QUEUE and ENABLE are audited events, not SCHEDULE or model inputs
label_definition.terminal: FAIL, FINISH, KILL, or LOST before first SCHEDULE within 5 seconds is competing non-start; pre-SUBMIT terminals and same-time collisions within 5 seconds are excluded
